picks.title: RADIOlogy: A Single-Pass Approach to Training-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
picks.takeaway: 无训练零样本异常检测，单次前向，免提示学习与滑窗。
picks.why: WACV 2027接收，代码开源；医学等专用域缺掩码时可迁移，尚无超声验证。

picks.title: Beyond Ground Truth: A Heuristic Unsupervised Quality Assurance Engine for Diagnosing Calibrational Blindness in Dental Segmentation
picks.takeaway: 无真值分割质控引擎，三阶段检查掩码质量与过度自信。
picks.why: 与“无干净参考品质评价”思路贴近；仅牙科X光验证，无超声实验。
